rulings.note: Drafted and read by the supervising session on 2026-11-12. Every page below was read directly that day. Only lines read against an official register, an official publication, or the first-party page of a party to the line are drafted, plus four reported surfaces (The Stack, TNW) that carry the two edges no official or first-party page states: Clifford's employment at Anthropic and ARIA's licence. Everything else from the run is in the candidate graph beside this intake, not in the ledger.
rulings.participant_time_fields: time_start and time_end on a participant give the dates the source states for that person's role; without them the participation row takes the surface dates.
rulings.known_gaps_not_in_this_pass: The ministerial meetings returns hold 22 rows naming Anthropic (21 meetings); the ledger holds 17 of them. The other five belong to the UK meetings lane: 2023-05-24 Rishi Sunak roundtable with DeepMind, Anthropic and OpenAI (his April to June 2023 return, not in the ledger); 2023-06-14 Chloe Smith with Dario Amodei (DSIT April to June 2023, a return the ledger holds; the row names Amodei with Anthropic in brackets); 2023-09-27 Oliver Dowden (Cabinet Office July to September 2023, held; row not entered); 2023-11-02 Oliver Dowden summit roundtable (Cabinet Office October to December 2023, not held); 2025-11-25 Andrew Western roundtable on AI in public services (DWP October to December 2025, not held).
